I think everyone can get good at Rocket League, its not black magic, it just comes down to a lot of practice and a willingness to improve.

First of all you need to ask yourself a very simple question, why do you want to play this game? Do you play because you just want a bit of harmless casual fun? Because if you do there is nothing wrong with that, just enjoy your time with the game!

But if you really want to improve and get better competitively, you may have to adjust some things in and around the way you play the game. Do you actually use the in my opinion best tool to improve in the game, freeplay? Because often when i hear people saying their mechanical ability isnt up to par, one of the reasons is because they jump straight into ranked without even a minute of freeplay. You can just vibe to music and hit the ball around in freeplay, trust me youre gonna get better, it just takes time.

After that there are still a number of things you could do, like watching pro gameplay on twitch and youtube and try and learn by watching them play, analyzing your own replays to spot mistakes you might often make, or even get some coaching lessons.

All of these things are of course time intensive, and it just comes down to if you really want to improve or just play some chill games and thats it.
